Antagonist speaker identified as Dr. Saotome only by reading forward into rows 9050-9064 (next slice), where he is addressed as "Doctor" and explicitly dies inside Shin Dragon; matches glossary character.jill... no, matches the Saotome entry ("Creator of Getter Robo; returns as antagonist under Invader control"). Recorded here since the identification depends on cross-slice context.

"kudan no genkai" translated as "that breaking point" (reading kudan as the classical set phrase, aforementioned/said, not a proper noun). No glossary entry or wiki source names a concept "Kudan" in this continuity; flagged for orchestrator confirmation rather than guessed silently.

Michiru is Michiru Saotome, Dr. Saotome's late daughter, per Getter Robo Wiki (not previously in project glossary). Full name used at first narrative mention (row 9083, next slice); short form used here since the line is dialogue, not narration. See batch_08955_glossary_proposals.json.
